target: Smöret och osten ligger på bordet.
english: The butter and cheese are on the table.
tip: An ett-word makes the definite by adding -et: smör becomes Smöret (the butter).

target: Buffén har mycket att välja på.
english: The buffet has a lot to choose from.
tip: The preposition stays at the end here: att välja på means to choose from.

target: Med tanke på vädret stannar vi inne.
english: Considering the weather we'll stay inside.
tip: Med tanke på is a set phrase meaning considering or in view of: med tanke på vädret.

target: Hem gick vi tidigt i helgen här.
english: Home we went early on the weekend here.
tip: hem = homeward (motion); hemma = at home (location): gick hem = went home.

target: Hur säger man det på svenska nu?
english: How do you say that in Swedish now?
tip: Man means a generic you or one: hur säger man is how do you say.

target: Hur vi löser problemet vet jag inte.
english: How we solve the problem I don't know.
tip: The whole clause Hur vi löser problemet fills the first slot, so the main verb comes next, before its subject: vet jag inte.

target: Det ska bli spännande på kvällen nu.
english: That will be exciting in the evening now.
tip: bli means 'become,' used for future states: det ska bli spännande = it will be exciting.

target: Pingvinen simmar snabbt genom det iskalla vattnet.
english: The penguin swims quickly through the ice-cold water.
tip: A definite ett-word with an adjective marks twice: det before it, and vattnet keeps its -et ending.

target: Pojken som bor bredvid oss spelar trumpet.
english: The boy who lives next to us plays trumpet.
tip: Som is the one relative word for both people and things: pojken som bor (the boy who lives).

target: Sällan ser man norrsken i södra Sverige.
english: Seldom do you see northern lights in southern Sweden.
tip: Front a negative adverb like Sällan and the verb comes before the subject: ser man.

target: Så fort jag kom hem somnade jag.
english: As soon as I got home I fell asleep.
tip: Så fort means 'as soon as.' The following main clause inverts: Så fort jag kom hem somnade jag.

target: Så fort tåget stannar kliver vi av.
english: As soon as the train stops we get off.
tip: Så fort means as soon as; the clause it opens comes first, then the main verb inverts: kliver vi.

target: Var ligger biblioteket på kontoret varje morgon?
english: Where is the library at the office every morning?
tip: varje means 'every' with a singular noun: varje morgon = every morning.

target: Ju mer jag läser, desto bättre förstår jag.
english: The more I read, the better I understand.
tip: Paired comparison: Ju mer in the first half, then desto plus the comparative in the second: desto bättre.

target: Jag heter Anna och jag kommer från Malmö.
english: My name is Anna and I come from Malmö.
tip: State your name with heter (am called), not the verb for to be: jag heter Anna.

target: Vi planterade ett körsbärsträd i trädgården förra våren.
english: We planted a cherry tree in the garden last spring.
tip: förra = last/previous for time periods: förra våren = last spring.

target: Tyvärr kan jag inte komma till festen på lördag.
english: Unfortunately I cannot come to the party on Saturday.
tip: Days of the week take på: på lördag means on Saturday.

target: Flickan med den röda klänningen dansar verkligen väldigt bra.
english: The girl in the red dress dances really very well.
tip: Bra means both good and well and never adds -t: dansar bra stays bra.

target: Detsamma, jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu!
english: Likewise, I understand how you feel right now.
tip: Detsamma means likewise, used to return a greeting or good wish: same to you.

target: En söt kattunge hittades utanför dörren till vår lägenhet.
english: A sweet kitten was found outside the door to our apartment.
tip: Add -s to a past verb to make it passive: hittades means was found, with no separate word for was.

target: Det satt en fågel på fönsterbrädan och sjöng vackert.
english: There sat a bird on the window sill and sang beautifully.
tip: Turn an adjective into an adverb by adding -t: vacker becomes vackert (beautifully) in sjöng vackert.

target: Under vintern är dagarna korta och mörka i norr.
english: During winter the days are short and dark in the north.
tip: Adjectives describing a plural noun take -a: dagarna are korta och mörka.

target: Det bästa vore att fråga någon som vet bättre.
english: The best thing would be to ask someone who knows better.
tip: Vore means would be, the conditional form of vara: det bästa vore (the best would be).

target: Huset på kullen har en fantastisk utsikt över hela sjön.
english: The house on the hill has a fantastic view over the whole lake.
tip: Hela (whole) sits before an already-definite noun with no extra article: hela sjön, not en hel sjö.

target: Det är en annan femma.
english: That's a different kettle of fish.
tip: "En annan femma" = a different five (coin) – a whole different story.

target: En svag rökpelare steg från stugan.
english: A faint column of smoke rose from the cabin.
tip: Stiga is a strong verb, so its past changes the vowel instead of adding an ending: steg (rose).

target: Har ni något vegetariskt på kvällen gärna?
english: Do you have anything vegetarian in the evening gladly?
tip: Yes or no questions put the verb first, before the subject: Har ni.

target: Vinodlaren skördade druvorna i september med familjen.
english: The winemaker harvested the grapes in September with his family.
tip: Regular -a verbs form the past with -ade: skörda becomes skördade (harvested).

target: I nattens stillhet hördes bara ugglans rop.
english: In the stillness of night, only the owl's call was heard.
tip: Possession just adds -s, with no apostrophe: ugglans rop means the owl's call.

target: Den stigande arbetslösheten är ett oroande tecken för landets ekonomi.
english: The rising unemployment is a worrying sign for the country's economy.
tip: Add -s for possession, even on definite nouns: landets ekonomi = the country's economy.
